title: Recent Progress in Fusion Energy Commercialization
query: recent progress in fusion energy commercialization
summary: The fusion industry is transitioning from experimental research to commercial power generation, with ~30 U.S. companies targeting grid connections in the 2030s, though significant engineering challenges remain in instrumentation and operational reliability.

items.title: Laser Inertial Confinement
items.subtitle: NIF-based approach

items.title: Alternative Concepts
items.subtitle: Stellarator, magnetic mirror, Z-pinch

items.title: Instrumentation & Control
items.subtitle: Critical gap

items.title: Operational Reliability
items.subtitle: Core requirement
items.body: Transition from one-off experiments to repeatable, efficient power generation cycles

items.title: Target Production
items.subtitle: Manufacturing bottleneck
